The adapter walked the page's own &month=&year= navigation FORWARD only (monthsAhead), never behind, so on 1 September every August sitting rolled off every page it read and the rebuilt snapshot carried the town with zero concluded meetings. The town published August the whole time: index.asp?Type=B_EV&SEC=…&month=8&year=2026 answered 200 with 25 events on 2026-09-02 (June: 200, 21 events). The test's fixed 'now' of 2026-08-15 was a second latent defect: once the 90-day window rolled past it every jurisdiction would have failed at once.

diagnoserDefect.observed: Both runs' 'Name the cause' step printed diagnose: CANNOT RUN — the run log could not be read, after gh api …/logs answered 404 and gh run view --log-failed answered 'still in progress'.
diagnoserDefect.cause: The diagnoser runs INSIDE the job it diagnoses; the Actions API does not serve a run's log until the run completes. The actions: read grant of 2026-08-28 fixed the permission, not the timing.
diagnoserDefect.fix: The gate step tees the suite's output to $RUNNER_TEMP/gate.log and names it in WTP_JOB_LOG; scripts/diagnose-failure.mts reads that file first and keeps the API paths as the fallback.

priorCommitStepFailures.evidence: Those rows record Commit-step failures: runs 32955499285 and 32833989579 (JOB04) died at Commit on the read-only GITHUB_TOKEN (HTTP 403 'Write access to repository not granted', no permissions block — NH202) and then on the ruleset (GH006 'protected branch hook declined' — NH203), and NH207 was the unproven deploy key. In runs 33517560447 and 33636708298 the Commit step never ran (conclusion: skipped), the refresh step exited 0, and the two run logs contain no push-main line, no GH006, no GH013 and no HTTP 403 (grep count 0 in both). The failing step is 'Validate before committing' — the suite refused the refreshed data — which is a different step, a different mechanism and a different remedy. The last refresh that landed on main is 2026-08-31 (68a70354 / 098497e2 / 2e633e01), which proves the credential, the ruleset bypass and the deploy key were working the day before these two failures.
